Synopsis:
Default camp dialog for Shadowheart's mom. She has recovered somewhat from her ordeal in the Shar grotto, but will never truly heal - she's grown old in captivity, and she's prone to confusion at times. Still, she remains glad and supportive.She has unique branches for Shadowheart and non-Shadowheart players, as well as branches that occur before and after CAMP_Shadowheart_DaughterTears, in which SH and her parents have their first proper heart to heart.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_ShadowheartMother.json: Emmeline Hallowleaf is Shadowheart’s elderly mother who was held in the Shar grotto and has only partially recovered — her captivity aged her and left her prone to confusion, but she remains warm and supportive. Off‑screen the family has only recently been reunited after that ordeal, and the camp conversation changes depending on whether the parents and Shadowheart have already had their first proper heart‑to‑heart (CAMP_Shadowheart_DaughterTears). She often frames her relief in religious terms (invoking the Moonmaiden/Selûne) and can speak of the family being “smaller” now, implying loss. Emmeline is protective of Shadowheart and will sharply rebuke players who insult or threaten her daughter; her tone and available lines also vary if the player is Shadowheart versus a non‑daughter interlocutor.
- CAMP_ShadowheartFather.json: Default camp dialog for Shadowheart's dad. He has started to  recover from her ordeal in the Shar grotto.He has unique branches for Shadowheart and non-Shadowheart players, as well as branches that occur before and after CAMP_Shadowheart_DaughterTears, in which SH and her parents have their first proper heart to heart following their reunion.
- LOW_SharGrotto_ShadowheartMother.json: Default dialog with Shadowheart's Mother (captive and freed)
- CAMP_Shadowheart_DaughterTears_SD.json: Shadowheart is found crying for the first time in decades, reflecting on events in the Grotto. If her parents are still alive, they will come to comfort her.
- LOW_SharGrotto_ParentsFate_OM_Shadowheart_COM.json: Shadowheart meets with her parents once again, who have been imprisoned for decades. A vision of Shar appears and demands Shadowheart sacrifice her parents.Note: there are two major tracks in this scene - if SH comes to it as a loyal Sharran who is intent on taking control of the church at her goddess's command, or as someone who has turned from Shar and is coming to rescue her parents.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Emmeline Hallowleaf: Moonmaiden's blessings to you. (node 34)
- Emmeline Hallowleaf: Much time was lost, but no more. Now we can be there for our daughter. (node 2)
- Player: You shouldn't even be here. You're a liability and a distraction for Shadowheart. (node 46)
- Emmeline Hallowleaf: Such cruel, pointless words Shar forces upon your lips. Leave me - I won't have my joy spoiled by her pawn. || [context] NodeContext: Tone hardening. She's not about to take shit from us just now. (node 47)

Sample 2:

- Player: I'm glad things worked out for you and your family. (node 52)
- Emmeline Hallowleaf: We are a small family - smaller than I hoped for - but we are whole again. (node 39)

Sample 3:

context: Emmeline Hallowleaf is Shadowheart’s elderly mother who was held in the Shar grotto and has only partially recovered — her captivity aged her and left her prone to confusion, though she remains warm and supportive. The family has only just been reunited after that ordeal, so camp lines change depending on whether Emmeline, her husband, and Shadowheart have already had their first proper heart‑to‑heart (CAMP_Shadowheart_DaughterTears). Emmeline often frames her relief in religious terms (invoking the Moonmaiden/Selûne) and will speak of the family being “smaller,” implying loss; she is also fiercely protective of Shadowheart and will sharply rebuke anyone who insults or threatens her. Her tone and available branches also differ when the player is Shadowheart versus a non‑daughter interlocutor.
